title: Randomized Controlled Trial of Moderate-Intensity Rosuvastatin With Ezetimibe Combination Therapy Versus High-Intensity Rosuvastatin on Progression of Coronary Atherosclerotic Plaque

sections.abstract: The aim of this prospective, open-label, randomized, single center study is to compare the effect of usual dose rosuvastatin plus ezetimibe and high-dose rosuvastatin on modifying atherosclerotic plaque.
